propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded: it conflates undeclared edits with genuinely no-file-impact tickets, causing whole-HEAD invalidation and container poisoning in both cases
A tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared, paths, none) with required no_file_impact_reason for the none state makes the distinction explicit and allows precise vs conservative attestation handling
An attestation for a ticket explicitly declaring no file impact should remain valid across unrelated commits, while undeclared tickets still invalidate on any commit
A container with mixed children (path-declaring and explicitly no-file-impact) should inherit only the path-declaring children's union without poison from no-file-impact children
A plan-review criterion must validate the no-file-impact assertion for truthfulness using LLM judgment only when the assertion is present
The declaration must be part of the material fingerprint so state transitions invalidate attestations and force re-review
